| Contract version | Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-S2-E3006-APP-23) |

```gherkin
Feature: Calculate the plan installment

  Scenario: AC6 A role without the right is refused and nothing changes (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a role without the right to re-run the step or read its result
    When the role tries to re-run the step or to read its result
    Then the access guard answers 403 with MSG-P4-002 and nothing changes
    And the step itself runs unattended under the service identity

  Scenario: AC7 A payoff older than the freshness limit is not used (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the payoff on the case is older than the freshness limit in force
    When the step is taken
    Then the step warns with MSG-S2-002, requests a fresh figure and computes nothing on the stale payoff

  Scenario: AC8 A second case signal while the branch is running writes no second element (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the plan-installment branch is running for the treatment
    When a second case signal arrives
    Then the inbox dedupes it by the cloud event id of the case signal and no second element is written

  Scenario: AC9 The business rules BR1 to BR8 hold (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the plan-installment branch calculates for a treatment with the accepted plan terms
    When the step completes or is blocked
    Then each rule BR1 to BR8 of section 8 holds: no constant amount, no copied ACE balance, no stale input used, one transaction for the element, plan terms and decision record, the versions recorded, and no case status changed by this service
```
